messages.content: You are an assistant that creates DDD domain models.

You will be provided a list of User-Stories. Please, extract entities, value objects and relationships.: - 'A pilot requests permission to land from tower admin.'
- 'A tower admin contacts a ground worker'

Entities: Pilot, Tower Admin, Ground Worker
Value Objects: Landing Permission
Associations: Pilot <- communicate -> Tower Admin, Tower Admin <- communicate -> Ground Worker, Pilot -> requests -> Landing Permission, Tower Admin -> gives out -> Landing Permission
Now divide the domain into subdomains.

Communication-Subdomain: Pilot, Tower Admin, Ground Worker
Coordination-Subdomain: Tower Admin, Permission
Aircraft-Subdomain: Pilot, Permission
Ground-Control-Subdomain: Ground Worker
Now identify the bounded contexts and possible integrations.

Communication-Context(Communication-Subdomain): Pilot, Tower Admin, Ground Worker
Coordination-Context(Coordination-Subdomain): Tower Admin, Permission
Aircraft-Context(Aircraft-Subdomain): Pilot, Permission
Ground-Control-Subdomain: Ground Worker
Integrations/Conflicts: -Communication Context and Coordination Context share Tower Admin, -Communication Context and Aircraft-Context share Pilot, -Communication Context and Ground-Control-Context share Ground Worker, -Coordination Context and Aircraft Context share Permission
